notes.title: New pack of buildings in asian style!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have a pretty cool update for you — we’re adding a whole new pack of buildings in asian style! Just like before you can change how your building looks by pressing F while placing the building where you want it to be. 

[h3]The following buildings are getting an additional appearance:[/h3]

- Airship
- Main building
- 2 residential buildings
- Market
- Farm
- Mill
- Mine
- Forester's house
- Sawmill
- Architect's House
- Sheep farm
- Butcher's house
- Smelter
- Forge
- Well
- Charcoal burner
- 4 decor elements of each size

[h3]Other changes and fixes[/h3]

- Fixed autosave of some games on exit
- Fixed loading some saves
- Fixed some crashes
- Fixed disabling keyboard + mouse controls
- Fixed freezes from a certain stage of the game
- Fixed pathfinding in some situations
- Slightly changed artificial intelligence

We hope you’ll enjoy this update! Tell us what you think about it in our Discord: 
https://discord.gg/w57PYDm6Tw

notes.title: Make Your Kingdom is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b]Make Your Kingdom[/b] is now available for everyone here on Steam! 🎉 And for those who are new to the game let us introduce it to you.

[b]Make Your Kingdom[/b] is a city-building game where you have to build, expand and improve your settlement. Become a leader of a brand new kingdom, keep your people happy and the economy thriving, fight orcs and have fun!

The game few features unique to its genre, such as:

[list]
[*] Play as a founder of the settlement - you can help build your kingdom, carry the resources, talk to other settlers and motivate them, fight off hordes of orcs with your own sword!
[*] Choose between a few different looks of various buildings - customize your settlement the way you want!
[*] No stress sandbox mode - create without any limitations! In this mode, your settlers can’t starve, get sick or die. Fires, weather conditions, earthquakes, and orcs can no longer destroy your buildings.
[*] The changing of the seasons - each season brings its own challenge, but all are equally beautiful.
[/list]
We can't wait to read all your comments and reviews and let's hope that the game runs smoothly for all of you! Soon we'll be posting a guide here for everyone that wants to have a bit more insight on the game but so far we'll let you dive in and explore on your own ;) Cheers! 🥂

[previewyoutube=S1t0Y95rmo4;full][/previewyoutube]

The changing of the seasons - each season brings its own challenge, but all are equally beautiful.

notes.title: New Game Mechanics and Release Date
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, founders![/h2]
We have some big news. 

For the last 3 years, we've been working tirelessly on Make Your Kingdom to make it the best low-poly kingdom ruler simulator in its genre - with interesting management and elaborate settlement building. All to fulfill our dream and give you a game you'll really like.

Previously we planned to release the game at the end of July 2021, which is very soon. But after extensive testing of Make Your Kingdom, we realized that the game needs to be improved. So we have to push back the release date, but not for long - Make Your Kingdom will be out within the next two months! 

We want to be honest with you, so we will tell you what kind of improvements the game needs. Over the next few weeks, we will be adding to the game mechanics of changing the appearance of the houses - now most buildings will have 2-3 different looks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942180/a816fdf41c8f7beea6b945c91c8a5dff016a61bd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942180/c1bfdf7af0bf40fd4a93567932536cd6fa6d1001.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942180/4828c244e9b1a40b73f40b1809ac61e9c2115155.jpg[/img]

In addition to dozens of new visuals, we need to test the technical part of this mechanic to avoid bugs and incorrect visuals. In addition, we will continue to catch bugs, so that the release of Make Your Kingdom will give you only pleasant emotions!

Thank you for staying with us! Without your support and attention, we wouldn't have made it this far. There's not much left and we're looking forward to MYK's release just as much as you are.

Don't forget to join our Make Your Kingdom community on Discord for exclusive development news before anyone else: https://discord.gg/YJPHUBWU 
And subscribe to our Twitter feed: https://twitter.com/make_kingdom
